title: review.v1
description: What the reviewer agent hands to the person's review (SUP.1 BP1, SWE.3 BP5): whether it asks for a person, what became of each finding over the review rounds, what the pull request does, each changed design told as stories from the design alone — a gap it approved is a question for the person, with what the build does there now — and, with the results, each software-level test described from the test alone and the cases expected of each criterion, listed from the criterion alone, with the test that checks each. A fenced ```yaml review block in the reviewer agent's review, written by post_review_tool --record. That an approval carries one, and which pull requests a person reviews, are rules of verify_delivery_reviewed_gate (classify_pull_request_tool); the person's review is posted by post_checkpoint_review_tool.

person.description: none, or why a person must review: one of the five conditions no file shows — 1 the rating looks too low, 2 the meaning is unclear, 3 beyond what was approved, 4 cannot be undone, 5 cannot be verified (or the same finding after three rounds) — and what it concerns.

findings.description: Every finding of every round on this pull request: fixed by a change (re-checked by the reviewer), withdrawn by the reviewer, or disputed by the author and left without a change.

tests.description: Each software-level test the person reads with the results, described in a session that saw the test only, never the requirement (agent/describe_tests_prompt.md): what it prepares, does and checks, and what a reader would expect that it leaves out.

expected.description: With the results: the cases expected of each acceptance criterion of the requirements the pull request proves, listed in a session that saw those criteria only, never the tests or the code (agent/expect_cases_prompt.md) — copied unchanged — each with the test that checks it, or missing. A missing case is a finding for the tester; one the reviewer agent holds wrong shows an unclear criterion, a question for the person.

test.description: The test that checks the case, as <file>::<test>, or missing.

summary.description: What the pull request does, in one plain sentence for a person who does not read code: written by the reviewer agent, shown first on the person's review.

stories.description: Each changed detailed design told as stories, in a session that saw the design only, never the requirements (agent/describe_design_prompt.md): one situation per story, step by step in plain words. Each step names its sources — a message of the design's sequence diagram, a unit of the design, or a decision its document names — and a step where the design does not say what happens is a gap, shown with ⚠. Copied unchanged from that session.

gaps.description: Each gap of a story the reviewer agent approved, with what the build does there now, so the person who keeps it knows what is kept: the behaviour in plain words, the lines of the product that decide it (path:line), and what follows for the user. With no line deciding it yet, now names the reading the build will take, and the comment says nothing decides it yet. Written by the reviewer agent, who reads the code: one per approved gap.

step.description: The gap step's text, as the story tells it.

now.description: What the build does there now; with no source, the reading the build will take.

source.description: The lines that decide it, as path:line from the product's root; empty when nothing decides it yet.

means.description: What follows for the user, e.g. what a run stopped midway leaves.
